info.name: CTI Platform
info.description:
Multi-tenant CTI middleware (Asterisk/FreePBX <-> CRM): click-to-call, screen pops, automated call logging, presence, recordings, WebRTC softphone, observability, admin.

## Setup
Set the collection variables (right-click collection -> Edit -> Variables):
- `baseUrl` — e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000 (or https://localhost:8443 behind Caddy)
- `tenantApiKey` / `tenantBApiKey` — printed once by `npm run seed`
- `adminApiKey` — ADMIN_API_KEY from .env
- `agentToken` — copy from the `Softphone / Agent login` response
- `zohoCallbackToken` — the Zoho integration's callback token (lab: zoho-callback-token-a)

## Auth realms
- Tenant API: header `X-API-Key`
- Softphone: `Authorization: Bearer <agentToken>`
- Zoho callback: header `X-Zoho-Token`
- Admin: header `X-Admin-Key`
- Recordings: the signed token IS the auth (no header)

## Not HTTP (use a WS client)
- `WS {{baseUrl}}/softphone-ws?token=<agentToken>` — the agent's call.* + agent.state stream
- `WS {{baseUrl}}/connector-ws?token=<connectorToken>` — reverse on-prem AMI tunnel
- `WS {{baseUrl}}/connector-files?token=<connectorToken>` — reverse recording file channel

## Webhooks OUT
Signed POSTs: `X-CTI-Timestamp` (epoch ms) + `X-CTI-Signature` = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`).

request.description: No auth. Human-facing. `ok` when every PBX connection is up, `degraded` otherwise.
Orchestrator liveness. 200 whenever the process serves.
Readiness: Postgres + Redis reachable. 200 ready, 503 not-ready. PBX-down does NOT fail readiness.
Prometheus text exposition. cti_calls_total, cti_call_events_total, cti_originate_total/_duration_seconds, cti_pbx_connection_up, cti_queue_jobs (all 5 delivery queues), + default Node metrics.
Status of driver='ari' connections (empty unless an ARI PBX connection is registered).

mode: spy (listen) | whisper (talk to the agent only) | barge (join). Rings the supervisor, then joins the agent's live call. Both extensions must belong to the tenant. Optional agentChannelId for ARI snoop.

response.name: Not a tenant extension
response.body: { "message": "supervisorExt and agentExt must be extensions of this tenant", "error": "Bad Request", "statusCode": 400 }

request.description: Live ACD stats for the tenant's PBX. Also streamed as `queue.stats` on the softphone WebSocket. Empty until queues are configured on the PBX.
Agent-leg-first: the agent's phone rings, then the PBX dials the number. Rate-limited per tenant (429 over the limit). The callRef reappears on the resulting call.* events.
In-flight calls of the key's tenant, read cluster-wide from Redis.
States: NOT_INUSE | RINGING | INUSE (from call lifecycle) | UNAVAILABLE (device unregistered).

exec: // Auto-capture the token into the collection variable.
try { const t = pm.response.json().token; if (t) pm.collectionVariables.set('agentToken', t); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Returns a short-lived HS256 token. The test script stores it in {{agentToken}}. Also used as ?token= on the /softphone-ws WebSocket.
SIP registration params for the softphone to register over wss and carry browser audio. 400 if WebRTC env / agent SIP creds are not configured.
What the softphone page (or Salesforce onClickToDial) calls. Agent identified by the token. Rate-limited per agent session.
Registered as the PhoneBridge click-to-call URL. Maps the Zoho user to an agent extension via Agent.crmRefs.zoho, then originates.

response.name: Unmapped Zoho user
response.body: { "message": "Zoho user zuid-9999 is not mapped to an agent", "error": "Bad Request", "statusCode": 400 }

request.description: Use the recordingUrl from a call.ended event verbatim — the token IS the auth (15-min expiry). Returns audio/wav; expired/tampered tokens 404. Direct connections read the local mount; reverse connections pull the file from the on-prem agent over the tunnel.
Connections, tenants, active calls, and health of all five delivery queues (webhook, zoho, salesforce, hubspot, dynamics).
Failed jobs across all delivery queues, retained for inspection.
Re-enqueue one failed job. Path: /admin/dead-letters/:queue/:jobId/retry (queue = webhook|zoho|salesforce|hubspot|dynamics).

Re-reads the DB registry; only changed PBX connections restart (live tunnels survive). Since Phase 12a this is BROADCAST over the cluster bus, so one call reaches every replica — previously the other replicas kept serving stale API keys and answered 401 for a newly created tenant. Responds {"status":"reload-broadcast"}.
mode reverse -> the connectorToken in the response is shown exactly once (give it to the on-prem agent). Run /admin/reload to apply.
The apiKey in the response is shown exactly once (stored as sha256).
crmRefs maps this agent to each CRM's user/owner id for pops + ownership.
config is non-secret; secrets are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Run /admin/reload afterwards.
Logs a completed Call Task. Pop/click-to-call is the client-side Open CTI softphone.
Logs a HubSpot Call engagement on call.ended. Pop/click-to-call is the client-side Calling Extensions SDK.
Logs a Dataverse phonecall activity on call.ended. Pop/click-to-call is the client-side Channel Integration Framework.

Which replica holds the lease for each PBX connection, and how long it has left. A PBX is driven by exactly one replica (ADR-0012), so `owned: []` on a replica is normal — it simply does not own that connection. This is the first thing to check when a connection looks down. Note the response differs per replica: `thisPod` and `owned` are local, `leases` is cluster-wide.
